contentHtml:
May 3, 2012

Learn about Dog Mushing

kathy highlight

Welcome Beginners!

If you are a beginner musher and want links to web sites/pages that will help you learn more about mushing, go to http://www.sleddogcentral.com/beginners/welcome.htm. It will take a little work to dig through this info … but hey! Get used to it! One thing that getting into sled dogs guarantees is plenty of hard work!
